audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was given to Locke while whys[4] directly under it says 'Level 6 holds even — the standoff persists while his execute setup is not yet fully online'.
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill for the first five stages, Locke at First item, Skill at 2+ items. First item already reads Locke in both layers and is correct.
audit.corrected: Level 6 -> Skill in both layers, rating 4/10 -> 5/10. Every other row already matches.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] holds only 3 entries where 4 are expected, and no spike covers Soul Ignition at all — the one window where Locke is deliberately damaging himself.
audit.why: Soul Ignition is 18/17/16/15/14s and Riot's text is explicit: he takes damage during the effect and only 'heal[s] back a portion of the damage he takes' at the END of the duration. That makes the duration itself a kill window and makes Grievous Wounds timing concrete rather than generic.
audit.corrected: Fourth spike created with before:null covering the Soul Ignition window and its 18s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Q is called 'Ritual Nails' throughout; Riot's own description says 'Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw'. Itemization also told the reader anti-heal is optional 'because his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal' — that reasoning is wrong, the refund is healing and Grievous Wounds reduces it.
audit.why: Nothing in the kit text contains the word Ritual. The anti-heal line is worse than vague: it actively talks a player out of the one item that answers his only sustain.
audit.corrected: Soul Nails used everywhere the nails are named; the anti-heal clause rewritten to point at Soul Ignition's end-of-duration refund.
sources: missingInteractions (names Soul Ignition, Ashen Pursuit, Silver Stake)

edits.after: Soul Ignition is 18s at rank 1 and he pays for it in his own health — the heal only refunds at the END of the duration, so kill him inside it or land Grievous Wounds before it expires and the refund never arrives.

notes: Locke's kit file carries no ability names for this champion (packet.enemyAbilities is null); the only names available anywhere in the brief are Soul Ignition (W), Ashen Pursuit (E) and Silver Stake (P) from missingInteractions, plus 'Soul Nails' from Riot's Q text. 'Ritual Nails' appears nowhere in the data — corrected to Soul Nails at Medium confidence. 'Purgatory' as the R name is likewise unsourced; rather than assert a replacement I removed it in favour of 'his R' where it appeared in strings I was already editing, and left the remaining occurrences alone. Also unverified: several strings claim Locke fights 'at 125 range' — his kit lists Q 950, W 250, E 425, R 1000 and no auto-attack range at all, so I could not confirm or correct it. breakdown.cooldowns previously claimed his E 'resets on takedowns' — nothing in the kit text says that; I dropped the claim rather than restate it.
